message: FleetLedger's Proxmox API token shipshape@pve!fleet expires on 2026-01-04 (in 3 days): then FleetLedger can no longer make, resize, snapshot or destroy Ships on Proxmox. Running Ships carry on.
subject: shipshape@pve!fleet
fix: Make a new token on the Proxmox host (docs/runbooks/proxmox-setup.md, step 1), then on the FleetLedger computer: ship-fleet setup --text --redo hypervisor. It records the new token's expiry.
